subject: Re: Ignite Labs cohort — split & activation of promotional credits
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@ignite-labs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ignite cohort credits — request to split between teams

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for running the pilot onboarding session last week — Ignite Labs got great feedback from our developer cohort. We have an allocation of 200k trial credits from our marketplace sponsorship and would like Redwood's help to split/activate them across two groups:

- Platform team (proof-of-concept, higher throughput): 140k tokens
- Developer cohort (sandbox, hands-on workshops): 60k tokens

Do you have a standard worksheet or activation process for splitting credits between multiple internal projects? We also want to confirm a 60-day activation window (instead of the default 30) to cover the workshop schedule.

Attached is a one-page program summary. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Tom
Senior Partnerships Manager
Ignite Labs

Attachment: ignite_cohort_overview.pdf (1 page stub)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@ignite-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ignite cohort credits — request to split between teams

Hi Tom — great to hear the session went well.

We can absolutely split the promotional credits by project. For partner-sourced credits we need two things to be in place before activation:

1) A short activation matrix listing project name, lead contact, and target window (I can accept a CSV).
2) Confirmation from your procurement team on the sponsoring commitment (email or PO is fine for our records).

We usually default to a 30-day activation period, but for instructor-led workshops we can approve a 60-day window as a one-time exception pending legal sign-off. I’m looping in Marissa (partner ops) and Karthik (finance) to confirm the allocation and terms.

If you can send the allocation spreadsheet and procurement contact, I’ll get the ops flow started.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Priya Natarajan

- 200k total promotional credits from partner sponsorship
- split 140k / 60k between Platform and Dev cohort
- 60-day activation windows, staggered start dates (Platform: 2027-01-04; Dev cohort: 2027-02-01)

Priya — thanks for the summary. Ops + finance ok on a conditional approval. Proposed plan:

- Approve 200k promo credits total, split as requested (140k / 60k).
- Issue two activation tokens: PLATFORM-IGN-140K (valid 2027-01-04 to 2027-03-04) and DEV-IGN-60K (valid 2027-02-01 to 2027-04-02).
- Implement route restriction: tags=ignite_cohort; allowed_routes=[generation] — this prevents embeddings endpoints from consuming credits.
- Legal to sign off on 60-day exceptions; I’ll send the terms doc to legal for a quick review.

Karthik: can you confirm there are no billing implications for org-level voucher accounting? If fine, we’ll proceed to generate tokens and notify Ignite with activation matrix + usage guardrails.

Marissa
Director, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
